reproducible_source_code: Source qualification only; synthetic receiver output b8a92bb205e8b919099607ead9cf08a06575580bd276999a3e99166c17404508. Original one-axis SciPy Euler-array shape refusal preceded any physical access.
source_intake: Source-only three complete preassigned trials 19,28,34. Decode only time/sampling, imu_gyr, imu_acc, imu_mag and source metadata. No optical positions/quaternions or movement mask in this phase. No held trial member or outcome. Source admission may inspect signed ranges, saturation proxy in µT, first-rest stability, rank and conditioning, training input-only predictability under frozen lag/window, and unusually large residuals. No hidden index or inferred attach/remove change based on target outcomes.
source_pilot_protocol: Reported sampling rate 2000/7 Hz. Estimate baseline gyroscope bias using first 20 seconds, then integrate commanded sensor-frame rotations by right composition of midpoint angular rates. Fixed calibration interval [0,60s). Fit at 20 nominal Hz using fixed 0.49 s transport pairs (140 source samples, 3.5ms each), evaluated on times at or after60s. Bias coefficients use only those prefix pairs. Compare zero offset, naive range-midpoint, algebraic sphere, authentic full hard/soft-iron ellipsoid, and gyro-transported hard-iron fits. Report prefix singular spectra and sustained room/constant-field differences; any future fallback/rank threshold frozen before held inputs. Full-length predictions and official movement-mask suffix optical scoring belong to a separate preregistration.
optical_ground_truth: Ground truth per-day independent calibration recording and per-trial optical/gyro temporal alignment; global yaw is magnetically defined on that separate recording. No held optical data used for initial conditions.
